claim: A-020 (analytics walk on Tuzlu Rüzgar, 2026-10-03): the engine returns paceDeltaPct and trendPerDayPct as 0-1 fractions ((current-previous)/|previous| in engine/comparisons.ts periodOverPeriod; OLS slope/|mean| in engine/statistics.ts trendPerPeriodPct), so /reports `pct` multiplies by 100 (a measured 0.2069 trend reads +20.7%, not +0.21%), and the export writes all six pace/trend sites through `pctOf` (x100) under the `percent` unit instead of tagging the raw fraction `percent`. Behaviour is pinned by rp-format.test.ts, ReportsNext.test.tsx (A-020 block) and report-export-cuttings.spec.ts (A-020 block); this verify asserts the shape they protect.

A-040 (analytics walk, 2026-10-03): TableAnalyticsService no longer says 'awaiting POS check feed (pos_checks is empty)' for an empty WINDOW; its four POS registers (tables, waiters, basket, hot tables) return checksInWindow and latestCheckAt from feedStatus, and only an empty window runs the one-row latest-check probe. On /reports and in the export, the room's 'absent attribution' and who-served-it's 'absent field on the POS feed' sentences sit only behind a checksInWindow > 0 branch; an empty window names the window and the latest check's day, a house with no check says none has reached Mudavym, and an older gateway that sends no count asserts neither cause. Pinned by table-analytics.service.spec.ts, ReportsNext.test.tsx and report-export-cuttings.spec.ts (A-040 blocks).
